name: 恶魔之吻
desc: ①：装备怪兽的攻击力上升700。②：这张卡从场上送去墓地时，支付500基本分才能发动。这张卡回到卡组最上面。
faq: If a "Sangan" or a "Witch of the Black Forest" equipped with "Malevolent Nuzzler" is Tributed and you activate the effect of "Malevolent Nuzzler", "Malevolent Nuzzler" goes on top of your Deck and then "Sangan" or "Witch of the Black Forest" is resolved. If "Sangan" is destroyed (not Tributed) the effects of "Sangan" and "Malevolent Nuzzler" are simultaneous and form a chain.
